notes: Restyle of the alumaetg 28.5 s aluminium linear-profile assembly reel in teak. Structure and beat durations are inherited from L2-linear-teak.json, which measured the reference's cut points at 10 fps: 8.1 / 0.4 / 3.1 / 1.5 / 11.9 / 0.6 / 2.9 s. cut:1.0 so `beats` are literal seconds. The reference's single 8.1 s assembly take is rebuilt as 2.5 + 2.2 + 1.7 + 1.7 of wipes so the assembly happens inside one take as theirs does; their 11.9 s ceiling-install take becomes canopy 4.5 + dark lines 3.7 + real workshop footage 3.7. NONE OF THEIR FOOTAGE IS USED - only the shot list and timings. Every frame is NixWoods: four teak assembly stages (stages 1-2 generated Sep 17 and recoloured to teak from our own teak photography; stages 3-4 DERIVED from stage 2 with numpy - diffuser = LED dots blurred to a continuous line, lit = warm bloom screen-composited) plus six real teak product photographs from teak-reels/hf/. Zero generation spend in this session. ONLY CHANGE vs L2: the hook line. 'this one is not aluminium.' scored 8/12 and FAILED the pull gate - it opens a gap but gives no reason to keep watching. Adding 'watch.' scores 9/12 with gap+truth+pull all passing, and it is literally what the next 6 s delivers. Source resolution was re-measured this session: t_endcap is 493 px (2.19x under contain) and t_strip 595 px (1.82x) - both stay out of the cut; every still that ships needs <=1.7x. AUDIO FIX: music7-noir.mp3 is 20.04 s but this cut is 26.25 s, so the bed died 6.2 s before the end - through the workshop beat, the room shot and the whole end card - while the engine's own afade-out at 24.85 s never fired. linear-reels/audio/music7-noir-x2.mp3 is the same track crossfaded into itself (acrossfade d=2.5) to 37.5 s; the engine trims and fades it as before. SHOT FIX: the workshop beat was in at ss 2.1, which lands after the craftsman has left frame - the contact sheet showed 3.7 s of a blurred bar with a cold blue window reflection, the one cold smudge in a warm reel, carrying the line 'we make it ourselves'. Sampled the clip every 0.4 s: the man with the pink polishing cloth is in frame from 0.0 to about 2.2 s. In-point moved to 0.0, which also takes the source margin from 0.13 s to 1.8 s on a 5.93 s clip.
name: L3-teak-assembly
